records.label: spacr.crops.build_png_channels#1
records.source: The returned array uses the same channel order as the PNG file, so in-memory and decoded representations have the same colour semantics.
records.context: The returned array uses the same image data channel order as the PNG file, so in-memory and decoded representations have the same colour semantics.
records.translation: 返回的数组使用与 PNG 文件相同的通道顺序，因此内存表示与解码后的表示具有相同的颜色语义。
